text: BTech students may be allowed to register for 15 to 21 credits from their third semester onwards by the concerned DUGC conveners on case to case basis.
A student who has obtained F grade in the pre-requisite(s) specified will not be eligible to register for the course.
A student shall be allowed to opt a maximum of 6 credits from MOOC based portals for considering against credit transfer during his/her entire program.
